typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	EndDate as timestamp (),
	EndDateFilter as string (),
	End_Dt as timestamp (),
	Environment as string (),
	ExportFile as string (),
	ExportFolder as string (),
	LOGMESSAGE_NBR_FATAL as integer (),
	LOGMESSAGE_NBR_INFO as integer (),
	LOGMESSAGE_NBR_WARNING as integer (),
	LOGMESSAGE_TEXT_PROCESS_COMPLETE as string (),
	LOGMESSAGE_TEXT_PROCESS_START as string (),
	StartDate as timestamp (),
	StartDateFilter as string (),
	Start_Dt as timestamp (),
	TemplateFile as string (),
	TextExportFolder as string (),
	TextFileDateStamp as string (),
	TextFileNameEnvironment as string (),
	TextFilesExportFilter as string (),
	TextFilesExportInd as integer (),
	Variable as integer ()
}

source(output(
		NY_PA_STAGING_PyID as string,
		CLOSE_DATE as date,
		MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		MARKET as string,
		CALLLIST_CD as string,
		SCRUB_DATE as date,
		SCRUB_RULE_CD as string,
		SCRUB_RULE_DESC as string,
		HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @P_STARTDATE DATETIME 	,@P_ENDDATE DATETIME 	,@STARTDATE DATETIME 	,@ENDDATE DATETIME  SET @P_STARTDATE = ? SET @P_ENDDATE = ?  IF @P_ENDDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @ENDDATE = CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) ELSE 	SET @ENDDATE = @P_ENDDATE  IF @P_STARTDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @STARTDATE = DATEADD(DAY, CASE  				WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, @ENDDATE) = 2 					THEN - 3 				ELSE - 1 				END, @ENDDATE) ELSE 	SET @STARTDATE = @P_STARTDATE  SELECT NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID 	,CAST(NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE AS DATE) AS CLOSE_DATE 	,M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER 	,M.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME 	,M.MEMBER_LAST_NAME 	,M.MEMBER_MCAID_PLAN_CD AS MARKET 	,CAST(CL.CALLLIST_CD AS VARCHAR(4)) AS CALLLIST_CD 	,CONVERT(DATE, CASE  			WHEN DATEPART(HOUR, CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) > 20 				THEN DATEADD(DAY, 1, CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) 			ELSE CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE 			END) AS SCRUB_DATE 	,COALESCE(ICR.CALLLISTRULE_CD, IGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_CD) AS SCRUB_RULE_CD 	,COALESCE(ICR.CALLLISTRULE_DESC, IGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_DESC) AS SCRUB_RULE_DESC 	,ACL.CALLLIST_NAME AS HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID 	AND CL.CALLLIST_CD IN (\'331\', \'332\', \'333\') 	AND CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE BETWEEN @STARTDATE 		AND @ENDDATE INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID 	AND ( 		CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID IN (2, 45) 		OR CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID = 0 		) INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = M.MEMBER_IID INNER JOIN PDS_NY_PA_HISTORY NPH ON NPH.NY_PA_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID 	AND NPH.NY_PA_MEMBERNUMBER = M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER INNER JOIN PDS_2008.DBO.PDS_NY_PA_STAGING NPS ON NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER 	AND NPH.NY_PA_pyID = NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_pyID LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE ICR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTGROUPRULE IGR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID = IGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID LEFT JOIN ( 	SELECT CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID 		,CL.CALLLIST_CD 		,CL.CallLIST_NAME 		,CLD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE 	FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CLD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CLD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CLM ON CLM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CLD.CALLLISTDATE_IID 		AND CL.CALLLISTGROUP_IID = 1 		AND CALLLISTMASTER_ACTIVE_IND = 1 	) ACL ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = ACL.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID 	AND CAST(ACL.CALLLISTDATE_DATE AS DATE) = CAST(CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE AS DATE) 	AND CL.CALLLIST_CD <> ACL.CALLLIST_CD 	AND CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID IS NOT NULL WHERE CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ACTIVE_IND = 0 ORDER BY SCRUB_DATE 	,MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> PDSScrubbedCallsCalls
PDSScrubbedCallsCalls split(TextFilesExportInd == 1, disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(ExportTextFile,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
PDSScrubbedCallsCalls derive({Copy of NY_PA_STAGING_PyID} = NY_PA_STAGING_PyID,
		{Copy of MEMBER_LAST_NAME} = MEMBER_LAST_NAME,
		{Copy of MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER} = MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER,
		{Copy of MARKET} = MARKET,
		{Copy of SCRUB_RULE_DESC} = SCRUB_RULE_DESC,
		{Copy of HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST} = HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST,
		{Copy of CALLLIST_CD} = CALLLIST_CD,
		{Copy of SCRUB_DATE} = SCRUB_DATE,
		{Copy of SCRUB_RULE_CD} = SCRUB_RULE_CD,
		{Copy of MEMBER_FIRST_NAME} = MEMBER_FIRST_NAME,
		{Copy of CLOSE_DATE} = CLOSE_DATE) ~> DataConversion
ConditionalSplit@ExportTextFile sink(input(
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		CLOSE_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		MARKET as string,
		MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		SCRUB_RULE_CD as string,
		SCRUB_RULE_DESC as string,
		HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST as string,
		NY_PA_STAGING_PyID as string,
		CALLLIST_CD as string,
		SCRUB_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME,
		CLOSE_DATE,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME,
		MARKET,
		MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER,
		SCRUB_RULE_CD,
		SCRUB_RULE_DESC,
		HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST,
		NY_PA_STAGING_PyID,
		CALLLIST_CD,
		SCRUB_DATE)) ~> ScrubFlatFile
